plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's mind. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your thinking and how you talk and decide. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: When the tension rises, both of you can become attached to your own version of the truth. They may experience you as limiting or overly cautious. You may experience them as disconnected from what is actually possible. The gift of this aspect is perspective, but under stress, perspective can harden into certainty, and certainty leaves little room to learn from one another.
advice: The invitation here is to stop treating the difference as a problem to solve. Their perspective can open doors you would never have considered, while your judgment keeps those possibilities connected to reality. Neither view is enough on its own. The real strength of this connection comes when vision and discernment work together, turning possibility into a roadmap you can actually follow.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your thinking and how you talk and decide.
